rule: hotspot = value ≥ region P90 (12.4) and ≥ the Elevated floor (31 µmol/m²); adjacent hotspots within 8 km form one cluster

notes.measurement: Sentinel-5P satellite HCHO vertical column, not ground-level air
notes.scale: database stores mol/m²; values here are ×1e6 = µmol/m²
notes.pass: one station-day = mean of that day's hourly column values
notes.resolution: TROPOMI pixel ≈ 5 × 3.5 km — stations inside one pixel are not independent
notes.relative: HCHO has no WHO/CPCB limit; hotspots are relative to the region on the pass date
